slides.title: Stop buying organizing bins. Do this first.
slides.sub: (Says someone with a closet of empty bins)

slides.title: Declutter before you contain
slides.body: Bins organize what you keep. If you buy them first, you're organizing stuff you don't want.

slides.title: Measure the space
slides.body: Shelf depth, drawer height, cabinet width. Write it in your phone notes. No more returns bag.

slides.title: Use what you already have
slides.body: Shoe boxes, delivery boxes, old baskets. Test the system for 2 weeks before buying anything.

slides.title: Buy for the habit, not the look
slides.body: If you toss things, get open bins. If you stack, get stackable. Match the bin to how you really behave.

slides.title: One zone at a time
slides.body: Buy bins for one zone, use them for a week, then move on. Bulk buying = a pile of unused bins.

slides.title: Buying bins felt like organizing. It was shopping.
Know what to do before you buy
slides.body: The Messy Brain Home Reset walks you through decluttering and zones before a single purchase. Link in bio.
